kinds.label: Frontier
kinds.gloss: A moving line the book names and hands to a later program.

kinds.label: Measurement
kinds.gloss: An operationalization of governance into measurable quantities.

kinds.label: Dynamics
kinds.gloss: A learning / organizational feedback the book models but does not test at population scale.

kinds.label: Generalization
kinds.gloss: Whether the theory holds beyond the software case it was built on.

agenda.title: Determinization frontier
agenda.one_line: How far judgment compiles into deterministic machinery — and how far it can be pushed by conjecturing the rungs not yet discovered.

agenda.title: Modeling moves the frontier
agenda.one_line: Richer representation expands what Alignment can determinize — Modeling and Alignment are causally interdependent, not parallel.

agenda.title: Assurance frontier
agenda.one_line: How much assurance emerges as a by-product of a model-rich governed environment (the MAGE-II conjecture); proximity to NIST AI RMF and UL 4600.

agenda.title: Development completeness & supply chain
agenda.one_line: What must be shared for an outsider to reproduce not the artifact but the capacity to evolve it; which environment artifacts join the supply chain.

agenda.title: Governance census
agenda.one_line: Inventory obligations against mechanisms; measure Coverage, Under-governance, and Governance-debt — with propagation-latency proposed as a future fourth metric.

agenda.title: Learning propagation + organizational scaling
agenda.one_line: How a lesson, once encoded into shared machine-actionable structure, propagates to later work; how the organization changes shape as agent throughput rises.

agenda.title: Generalization beyond software
agenda.one_line: Whether the answer generalizes to model-based engineering at large (Siemens, Zenseact) — the widened core question of MBAE.
